summary: Since the TRILL base protocol was published in 2011, deployment has revealed errata in RFC 6325 and areas needing clarification. This standards-track RFC gathers corrections, clarifications and updates for it. It updates RFC 6325, RFC 7177 and RFC 7179.

eli5.summary: After a big rulebook has been in use for a while, people find mistakes and unclear parts. This is the list of fixes and clearer wording.
